name: @penguinharness/reflexion-rsi-toolkit
description: The Reflexion RSI Toolkit: verbal reinforcement learning (Shinn et al., 2023, https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.11366) — after every measured trial a Reflector distills the score matrix and the failed cases' public statements into one written reflection, the Target carries the reflection buffer into its next trial, and the best-scoring State is kept. Self-contained: it creates the Target's reflection slot, evaluates its own cells and writes the Evaluation Center's scoreboard.
